name: Krishna Moorthy P
summary:
Seasoned HR professional with 12.5 years of experience in the BFSI, NBFC, and MFI sectors, excelling in HR Business Partnering,
employee relations, and talent acquisition.
Expertise in managing multi-state HR operations across 4 South Indian states, supporting a workforce of 4000+ employees and leading HR
teams of 7-10 members.
Proven track record of enhancing employee engagement, reducing attrition rates, and strategically aligning HR initiatives with business
objectives to drive growth.
Proficient in HR analytics and MIS reporting, utilizing data-driven insights to inform HR strategies and improve organizational performance.
Successfully reduced time-to-fill key positions by 15% through optimized hiring processes and effective talent acquisition strategies.
Implemented comprehensive employee engagement programs that improved employee satisfaction and contributed to a positive workplace
culture.
Led HR operations encompassing recruitment, employee relations, compliance, and training across various locations and business units.
Strong understanding of statutory compliance and payroll inputs, ensuring adherence to legal and regulatory requirements.
Adept at employee grievance handling, performance management, and stakeholder management to create a harmonious and productive
work environment.
